title: Junior Laravel Developer
description: Join our backend team and build APIs and admin panels with Laravel.
requirements: Good knowledge of PHP and Laravel basics. Familiar with MySQL and Git.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain Laravel features. Write migrations, models and tests. Fix bugs reported by QA.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: Lead the development of our SaaS platform from database to UI.
requirements: 5+ years with PHP/Laravel and a modern JS framework. Experience with Docker and CI.
responsibilities: Design architecture, review code, mentor juniors and own delivery of major features.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Learn on real datasets while supporting our analytics team.
requirements: Studying CS, statistics or similar. Basic Python and SQL.
responsibilities: Clean data, build simple dashboards and prepare weekly reports.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy ML models for recommendation and matching features.
requirements: 3+ years in Python and ML. Experience deploying models to production.
responsibilities: Train and evaluate models, build data pipelines and monitor model quality.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design clean and modern interfaces for web and mobile products.
requirements: Strong portfolio. Hands-on with Figma and design systems.
responsibilities: Create wireframes and prototypes, run quick user tests and hand off designs to developers.

title: SEO & Content Specialist
description: Grow organic traffic for our clients through content and technical SEO.
requirements: Experience with SEO tools. Excellent writing in Arabic and English.
responsibilities: Plan content calendars, write articles and report on rankings monthly.

title: Freelance Social Media Manager
description: Manage social accounts for a portfolio of retail brands.
requirements: Proven social media campaigns and basic design skills.
responsibilities: Schedule posts, answer comments and deliver monthly performance reports.

title: Warehouse Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinate daily inbound and outbound operations in our Alexandria warehouse.
requirements: Bachelor degree. Good Excel skills and ability to work in shifts.
responsibilities: Track shipments, manage the warehouse team schedule and report KPIs.

title: Customer Support Agent
description: Help customers track their orders and solve delivery issues.
requirements: Fluent Arabic, good English. Calm and clear communication.
responsibilities: Answer calls and chats, log tickets and escalate complex cases.

title: Frontend React Developer
description: Build responsive dashboard and customer-facing interfaces for our SaaS products.
requirements: Two years of JavaScript and React experience. Comfortable consuming REST APIs and using Git.
responsibilities: Implement product screens, collaborate with designers, and maintain reusable frontend components.

title: Node.js API Developer
description: Develop reliable Node.js services that support integrations and high-volume workflows.
requirements: Experience with Node.js, TypeScript, SQL, and REST API design.
responsibilities: Build API endpoints, document integrations, and improve observability for backend services.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description: Plan and optimize paid and organic acquisition campaigns for regional consumer brands.
requirements: Hands-on campaign reporting, Google Analytics, content planning, and clear communication skills.
responsibilities: Manage weekly performance reports, propose experiments, and coordinate campaign content with designers.

title: Visual Design Intern
description: Support social, campaign, and presentation design work alongside our creative team.
requirements: A portfolio that shows visual design fundamentals and familiarity with Figma.
responsibilities: Prepare campaign assets, adapt templates, and organize design files for client teams.

title: Logistics Data Coordinator
description: Turn daily warehouse and delivery data into practical reports for the operations team.
requirements: Strong Excel and SQL skills. Familiarity with Power BI and logistics metrics is preferred.
responsibilities: Clean operational data, publish daily dashboards, and flag delivery or inventory trends.

title: Customer Success Supervisor
description: Coach a small support team serving business customers across delivery and fulfillment accounts.
requirements: Customer-service experience, CRM familiarity, and strong communication and reporting skills.
responsibilities: Review support quality, monitor customer issues, and coordinate service improvements with operations.

title: Junior Financial Analyst
description: Support monthly reporting, budgeting, and business-performance analysis for finance clients.
requirements: A finance, accounting, or business degree with strong Excel and financial-modeling skills.
responsibilities: Prepare reports, maintain planning models, and summarize financial performance for managers.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description: Maintain supplier invoices and payment records for a portfolio of growing businesses.
requirements: Practical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office.
responsibilities: Reconcile invoices, prepare payment schedules, and respond to supplier-account queries.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Run end-to-end hiring campaigns for technology, finance, and operations clients.
requirements: Recruitment experience, proactive sourcing, and confidence working with an applicant tracking system.
responsibilities: Source candidates, coordinate interviews, manage pipelines, and report hiring progress to clients.

title: HR Operations Intern
description: Learn the foundations of onboarding, employee records, and people-operations support.
requirements: A current HR, business, or psychology student with organized Microsoft Office skills.
responsibilities: Assist with onboarding checklists, maintain employee records, and prepare simple HR reports.
